description: This Java class 'LabelReferences' scans project files for references to label keys, including usage in XML, Java, Groovy, and template files, to accumulate annotation of where labels are used across the project.

classes.name: LabelReferences
classes.description: Main class responsible for identifying and recording references to label keys across various project files including XML, Java, Groovy, and template files.

methods.name: getLabelReferences
methods.description: Main method orchestrating the scanning for label references in multiple file types and returning a map of label keys to their reference locations.

methods.name: setLabelReference
methods.description: Records a reference to a label key from a specific file, incrementing count if already recorded.

methods.name: getLabelsFromFtlFiles
methods.description: Extracts label keys used within FreeMarker template files (*.ftl).

methods.name: getLabelsFromJavaFiles
methods.description: Extracts label keys referenced within Java source files.

methods.name: getLabelsFromGroovyFiles
methods.description: Extracts label keys used within Groovy script files.

methods.name: findUiLabelMapInMessage
methods.description: Identifies label keys within getMessage calls in source code.

methods.name: findUiLabelMapInPattern
methods.description: Finds label keys matching specific patterns within source code.

methods.name: findUiLabelMapInFile
methods.description: Extracts label references from inline label map usage in files.

methods.name: findLabelKeyInElement
methods.description: Searches XML content for label keys within specified elements.

methods.name: getLabelsFromSimpleMethodFiles
methods.description: Extracts label keys from simple XML configuration files.

methods.name: getLabelsFromFormWidgets
methods.description: Parses form widget XML files to find label key references within form elements.

methods.name: getLabelsFromOfbizComponents
methods.description: Scans ofbiz components XML files for label references.

methods.name: checkOfbizComponentTag
methods.description: Inspects specific XML tags in OFBiz component configuration files.

methods.name: getAutoFieldsEntityTag
methods.description: Gathers field names from entity definitions in configs.

methods.name: getAutoFieldsTag
methods.description: Searches tooltip attributes in XML for label key references.

methods.name: getAutoFieldsServiceTag
methods.description: Inspects service parameters to find label key references.

methods.name: getWebappTag
methods.description: Extracts labels from webapp configuration elements.
